about:
Boston Semi Equipment (BSE) is based in Littleton, Massachusetts. The company was founded to address the growing need for flexible IC test solutions, thriving on solving complex technology problems with production-ready electronic test handling equipment built for the long haul.

BSE designs and manufactures advanced test handlers, including the Zeus series of gravity handlers and the Panacea series of pick-and-place handlers, with variants for tri-temperature, MEMS, high-voltage, and high-accuracy applications. Beyond hardware, the company provides a full suite of services: installation, warranty, training, parts replacement, field service, relocation, calibration, and repair of legacy ATE boards and systems. Repair work is performed at ISO-certified facilities in Thailand and the Philippines, supported by regional logistics centers that maintain extensive parts inventories.

The company serves semiconductor device testing customers across automotive, electrification (wide-bandgap semiconductors), collaborative technology (connectivity and smart devices), aerospace, medical (MEMS), and AI and big data markets. BSE also supports the global installed base of legacy ATE equipment and test cells long after original manufacturers phase them out.

BSE emphasizes close customer partnerships as its core differentiator, stating that its biggest accomplishments result from collaborations that push the edges of technology and deliver exceptional value for today and tomorrow. The business was motivated by the need for flexible, production-ready test handling equipment that endures.
